verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's vendor docs describe round-robin pooling that routes each booked meeting to a team member. Admins choose between random selection or cycling through members for equal distribution, which is aimed explicitly at sales teams. Per-day, per-week and per-month meeting caps help keep load fair. However, nothing in the evidence shows weighting or priority settings for team members, which the story explicitly asks for. Missing for 10: weighted or priority-based round-robin assignment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
